results.title: No Other Way
results.overview: The film tells the story of Anatoly Evgenievich Kurkovsky, head of the medical unit for people experiencing homelessness at Botkin Hospital in St. Petersburg. This unique facility, the only one of its kind in Russia, was established 23 years ago with the participation of the international organization Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders). Every day, dramatic, sometimes touching, and occasionally comical events unfold here.

results.title: The Blue Skies of Haru
results.overview: In this personal documentary, L.A. Alfonso turns images gathered on his phone into an encounter with memory, discovering that love has been the impulse behind his constant filming. Told through a voice reading the filmmaker’s words and composed for the vertical frame, the film explores family, distance, and the possibility of holding cinema in your hand.

results.title: Joy of Joys
results.overview: This documentary goes behind the scenes at Abbey Road Studios to capture the recording of the Mercury Prize–nominated HELP(2), a 2026 charity album from War Child Records, which aids children in conflict zones around the world. To make the film, Glazer enlisted some crucial help: young schoolkids from London were equipped with their own digital cameras and encouraged to shoot the studio recordings any way they wanted. Their curiosity and creativity are paralleled in footage taken by high-spirited children in war-torn parts of the globe—Gaza, Sudan, Ukraine, Yemen—whom Glazer also supplied with cameras. The resulting film, which Glazer and regular music collaborator Mica Levi have dubbed “by children, for children,” serves as a testament to youthful openness and wonder amidst the evils of the adult world.
